In [18]:
plt.figure(figsize=(8,5))

plt.plot(df.index,
         df["SepalLengthCm"],
         
         color="red",
         marker="o"
        )
plt.title("Sepal Length")
plt.xlabel("Sample Number")
plt.ylabel("Sepal Length(cm)")

plt.show()
In [20]:
plt.boxplot(df["PetalWidthCm"])
plt.title("Petal Width")
plt.ylabel("Width(cm)")
plt.show()
In [21]:
plt.hist(df["SepalWidthCm"],
         bins=6,
         color="blue",
         edgecolor="black"
        )
plt.title("Sepal Width Distribution")
plt.xlabel("Sepal Width")
plt.ylabel("Frequency")
plt.show()
In [22]:
plt.bar(df["Species"].value_counts().index,
        df["Species"].value_counts().values,
        color="brown",
        label="Flower Count")
plt.title("Numberof Flowers in Each Species")
plt.xlabel("Species")
plt.ylabel("Count")
plt.legend()
plt.show()
In [23]:
plt.scatter(df["SepalWidthCm"],
            df["PetalWidthCm"],
            color="green",
            s=100
           )
plt.title("Sepal Width vs Petal Width")
plt.xlabel("Sepal Width (cm)")
plt.ylabel("Petal Width (cm)")
plt.show()
In [29]:
plt.pie(df["Species"].value_counts(),
        labels=df["Species"].value_counts().index,
        autopct="%1.1f%%",
        startangle=90)

plt.title("Iris Species Distribution")
plt.show()
In [30]:
explode = [0.1, 0, 0]

plt.pie(df["Species"].value_counts(),
        labels=df["Species"].value_counts().index,
        autopct="%1.1f%%",
        startangle=90,
        explode=explode)

plt.title("Iris Species Distribution")
plt.show()
